milestones.outcome: The three slices with no prerequisite land together: a calm title row and a full-width review bar replace the composition entry row, the core and the host hold each window's document tabs with their own comparisons, and the right tray's header becomes Comments and Findings tabs.
exit_criteria: The title row holds only Home, the drawer toggles, the pull request's name, and at its right the modality beside refresh, the comments toggle carrying the new-comment count, account and settings, with the platform's window controls; no navigation, progress or composition control sits in it, and every control stays top level at each platform's width floor.

The review bar sits directly under the title row at full width and reads, from its left, Updates and the comparison with its dates and menu, previous and next change with the position, previous and next file with the position, and private progress as an icon whose tooltip names the file's state; Compose review and Comment are icons at its right whose tooltips name the command and its key, Compose review marks a kept review draft, and Review details opens from the comparison's menu.

The composition entry row is gone and nothing else sits between the title row, the review bar and the Updates line in any state or modality; Option-R (Alt+R), Option-C (Alt+C) and Esc back from a composition page work, both commands are in the Pull Request menu, and no key sequence is used twice in the assembled window.

BPR-0940's window course, the focus-order and unique-shortcut course, the UIforETW capture's exact rows and the height floors in the capture and its course script follow the new arrangement with measured stacks, the composition pins are resealed with a recorded review, and the Windows and Linux measurements and width sweep are recorded as owed station runs with exact commands.

Core transition tests cover every document-tab operation, host tests cover per-tab completion routing and stale rejection, and restoration keeps tab order, the active tab, each tab's comparison and position and the window's comparison, with two tabs on one file and different pairs staying distinct and exact through refresh and restart.

The right tray's header holds Comments and Findings tabs, each showing only its own content with its tools beneath the tabs; switching keeps each tab's scroll and selection, keyboard and accessibility reach every tab, the Comments tab keeps the aligned cards exactly, and the drawer's toggle, width and modality presets are unchanged.

Rendered evidence at 100, 125 and 200 percent covers the visual changes, focused courses pass with negative controls on the exact candidate, the workbench specification describes the built chrome, the documentation gate passes, and task-owned commands are quiescent.
milestones.boundary: BPR-1129, BPR-1131 and BPR-1134 only. The Updates line's fold and caption (BPR-1130), the tab strip (BPR-1132) and Comment and Reply targets (BPR-1133) belong to m2. Windows and Linux station runs and the owner's attended look at the built chrome on macOS and Windows stay pending until actually supplied.

milestones.outcome: The slices that build on the review bar and the tab model land: the Updates line folds and loses its permanent caption, the comparison's header becomes the document tab strip, and Comment and Reply act where the line and the thread are.
exit_criteria: The owner's answer on where the readiness words go is recorded before BPR-0795's row changes; the Updates line folds from the review bar's disclosure and by keyboard without moving the bar, a new window starts folded, each window restores its own choice, and nothing folds or opens on its own.
The Updates line carries no permanent caption; its tooltip carries the history statement and a mark shows whenever history is incomplete or ambiguous, in every modality.

The comparison's header is the tab strip: names elide from the left, a tab with its own pair shows it, the width floor shows the active tab and a count, the tab menu offers Duplicate, Close, Close others, returning to the window's comparison and making the tab's pair the window's; Cmd-click (Ctrl-click) and Open in New Tab open tabs, and Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab and Cmd-W (Ctrl+W) are bound uniquely.

The Updates line shows the active tab's pair and Overview and Discuss the window's; a tab over an older pair places only its own revisions' threads, says how many are on later updates and routes to them, and offers no new comment off the current head; the composed course opens a file in a new tab, compares two pairs of one file side by side, closes, restarts and returns.

Comment starts a comment on the current line or a reply to the selected thread and its menu names the target; thread cards beside the code offer Reply through the Discuss path; nothing publishes without the existing explicit Publish.

The height floors are re-taken with the Updates line open and folded and the tab strip in place, the width floors are swept again, focus, accessibility-name and 100 to 200 percent scale checks pass at narrow and wide windows, and the documentation gate passes.
milestones.boundary: BPR-1130, BPR-1132 and BPR-1133 only. Conventional Comments labels (RFC-BPR-0048) and the Tour tab (RFC-BPR-0039) are not invented here. Station runs and attended acceptance stay pending until supplied.

milestones.outcome: The slices that the owner's 2026-09-25 verdicts on the built m2 chrome, and his direction that day on the second tray tab's purpose, call for land before closeout. The readiness words move into the Updates track or the review bar's summary. The bar puts file before change. Compose review and Comment explain themselves and never open an unusable page. The second tray tab becomes Notes, the reviewer's private space: a thread's defect controls move onto the thread, Dif leaves the drawer for the status bar's corner, and private notes are written there and promoted to drafts in Comments. A tab over an older pair hides later threads until Show them. The plus activates its tab, and tabs fill the strip, shrink and then scroll.
exit_criteria: While a pull request loads or its comparisons are unavailable, the readiness words appear in the Updates line's track when it is open and in the review bar's summary when it is folded, in every modality. BPR-0795's readiness row is gone, the window course no longer allows reviewReadiness between the title row, the review bar and the open timeline, and the height floors hold open and folded, loading and loaded.

The review bar reads file navigation before change navigation, as AC-03 is amended, at every scale and at the width floor, and the focus order follows the visual order. The window rows and the UIforETW capture's 14-action order in all four appearance profiles assert it, and any composition pin the change touches is resealed with its recorded review.

Why the frozen candidate's Compose review showed the invalidated-authority state is established. In every state it can be in, the Compose review page says what it is, what state the draft is in and what to do next, and every unavailable action says why.

The second tray tab is Notes, as decided on BPR-1204 under the owner's delegation after his direction on its purpose. Its label, tooltip, accessible names, the action that selects it and its empty state say it is the reviewer's private space for non-public notes and AI conversations and review feedback; it shows whether or not an agent is configured, and it holds no thread's controls and no Dif. The workbench specification and the window, focus-order, accessibility and composed courses that named Findings follow Notes, with a negative control.

On a tab over an older pair the Comments tray lists only the threads of the tab's revisions, its notice names how many are on later updates, and Show them reaches them. A current-head tab shows every thread and no notice.

The plus duplicates the active tab's exact view and makes the copy the active tab with focus in it. Tabs share the strip equally, fill it, shrink to a minimum width and then scroll, by one rule at every width including the floor, keeping the active tab in view and the plus reachable, as decided on BPR-1206 under the owner's delegation.
Comment never opens an unusable page. Without a current-head line it is unavailable and says why, or it takes a defined line, and the inline page never shows empty panels or actions that cannot act.

Every thread card, in Comments, in Discuss and beside the code, opens a context menu by right-click and by the context-menu key or Shift+F10, listing its actions and Classify as defect, or for a defect its verdicts and Reclassify. A defect's card shows its state and classification on a badge button that opens the same actions, and Previous and Next defect with the position sit beside Next new comment. The tray's second tab holds none of these, every control dispatches the same core defect command as before, and RFC-BPR-0009's defect courses pass unchanged.

Dif is not in the right drawer. On every workbench surface without a prime spot he rests at 40 pixels in the status bar's corner with no pointer or focus path, stepping aside for transient messages; the signed-out first-time Home and BPR-0966's Compose workshop slot are his prime spots, and the one-sprite rule holds. Each RFC-BPR-0031 cue plays where he is with its unchanged trigger, the placement courses follow RFC-BPR-0031's owner amendment with a negative control, and BPR-0800 closes on this evidence.

The Notes tab lists the pull request's private notes from the existing ledger, and the reviewer writes, edits and deletes a note on the pull request or the current file through the existing ledger port. Promote to draft on a note or a selected side-chat reply creates a local draft at Comment's target with the item's text, keeps the source and publishes nothing before the explicit Publish; findings keep RFC-BPR-0012's conversions, and a composed course shows zero GitHub mutation, with a negative control.

Each slice's focused Qt and composed courses pass with negative controls on the exact candidate, renders at 100, 125 and 200 percent are inspected where the chrome changes, and the documentation gate passes. Each card's owner question on macOS is asked on its own and stays pending until supplied.
milestones.boundary: BPR-1201 to BPR-1210 only. BPR-1201 to BPR-1207 were placed before m3 by the owner's approval of 2026-09-25; BPR-1208 to BPR-1210 were added the same day under the owner's delegation of every open choice about the second tray tab, because AC-09 as amended cannot be met without them. The m2 cards stay Done, and their verdicts stay bound to the frozen m2 app. BPR-1204's name, Notes, was chosen under the owner's delegation, is built after BPR-1208 to BPR-1210, and changes only by a new owner decision. BPR-1209 amends RFC-BPR-0031's placement only; BPR-0966's Compose workshop slot and its verdict are unchanged, and RFC-BPR-0023 stays Deferred. Windows and Linux station runs and each card's owner look stay pending until supplied. Nothing here changes publication, authority, provider, Git or storage capability; notes are written through RFC-BPR-0007's existing ledger port.
